Property.name: NodeType
Property.Description:
The type of node
Interface = Where the interfaces run
Server = Message bank or any instance other than one that runs interfaces

Property.name: ServerHost
Property.Description: The server host/server address (the EAI NS on the message bank, generally)

Method.name: Init
Method.Implementation:
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try {
#; Check if any entries already exists Set SQLCODE = "", tRecordCount = 0 &sql(SELECT COUNT(%Id) INTO :tRecordCount FROM IHC_EAI_System_Data.Instance) If ((SQLCODE '= 0) && (SQLCODE '= 100)) { $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Failed to count Instance table")) }
Quit:((pReset = 0) && (tRecordCount > 0))
#; Clear all Set SQLCODE = "" &sql(DELETE FROM IHC_EAI_System_Data.Instance) If ((SQLCODE '= 0) && (SQLCODE '= 100)) { $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR($$$GeneralError,"Failed to clear Instance table")) }
